content:
Ads are about to roll out in Apple Maps in the US and Canada, and businesses can start booking ads from today. Here are the details, including a limited-time promotional offer.

Businesses can book Apple Maps ads starting today

If you own a business and want to advertise through Apple Maps, the booking service officially launched today.

Although users haven't yet seen the ads officially go live, Apple is preparing for a full rollout and is now letting businesses start booking ads.

Full information on ad booking has been published on the Apple website, including details on how to get started.

Apple is also offering a special limited-time promotional offer, details as follows:

This offer is available to eligible merchants who book map ads with credit card payment on or before October 11, 2026.

As mentioned earlier this year, ads will appear in two locations within Apple Maps:

  • Before the user searches: sponsored business listings will appear in the "Suggested Places" section of the search screen.
  • After the user searches: when the search results are relevant to the search query, ads will appear among the results.

If you're considering advertising through Apple Maps, Apple also has a dedicated webpage explaining its advertising policy; click here for details.

Apple says Apple Maps receives more than a billion business-related searches every month, and one out of every two business searches leads a user to take action. In addition, according to the GWI Core Study in Q1 2025, Gen Z and Millennials make up 57% of Apple Maps users.
